Privacy

I collect very little, I use it to write back to you, and I don't sell it.

Here's what this site collects, where it goes, and what it doesn't do. This notice covers this website, eberryvashon.com. It's effective October 18, 2026.

What it collects What it doesn't do

What this site collects

Only what you type into a form on this site. There are three, and each one asks for just this:

  • The inquiry form

    On the home page and on the Courthouse Square page.

    • Name
    • Email
    • Phone (optional)
    • I'm interested in
    • What are you looking for?

    On the Courthouse Square page it also notes which building page you wrote from.

  • The listing form

    At the bottom of each listing's page.

    • Name
    • Email
    • Phone (optional)
    • Move-in timeframe
    • Anything I should know?

    It also notes which listing and building you asked about.

  • The owner form

    On the For owners page.

    • Name
    • Email
    • Phone (optional)
    • What kind of property?
    • Property address
    • Tell me about it

That's all of it. I use it to write back to you, and for nothing else. If you'd rather not use a form, you can email me at me@ebberry.com. Then I have your email address and whatever you write.

Where it goes

This site is hosted by Netlify, and its form tool is how your note reaches me. When you send a form, Netlify stores your submission and emails it to me.

I use it to write back to you. I don't sell it, and I don't show you ads. As with any web host, Netlify also handles the requests your browser makes to load these pages; Netlify's privacy statement says what it collects.

What this site doesn't do

The site's own checks look at every page and script for these.

  • No cookies

    Nothing on these pages sets a cookie.

  • No analytics

    There's no analytics code here, so I'm not counting or following you.

  • No ads or trackers

    Nothing on these pages loads advertising or tracking code.

  • A map that stays here

    The map is drawn from files on this site, so showing it doesn't send anything to a map company.

The one outside request

The one thing a page asks another company for is its typefaces: Fraunces, Inter and Anton come from Google Fonts. When your browser asks Google for them, Google receives that request, which includes your IP address. Google's privacy policy says it also collects the date and time of the request and the address of the page that made it, and it explains what Google does with that.

Google's privacy policy →

Links out, and Ledger

Some links leave this site: the Windermere logo goes to windermerevashon.com, "Lease documents" goes to courthousesquarevashon.com, and the map's credits and "Open in OpenStreetMap" links go to openstreetmap.org and protomaps.com. Those are other people's sites, and they have their own practices. This notice covers eberryvashon.com only.

Ledger, the portal where tenants and owners sign in, is a separate system. Its privacy notice is shown inside the portal.

Your choices

Email me at me@ebberry.com and I'll show you what you've sent me. If you'd like it deleted, tell me and I'll delete it.

If this notice changes, I'll change the date at the top.
